title: Why Plague Doctors Wore Bird Masks

sections.name: Why Plague Doctors Wore Bird Masks
lines: This is one of the creepiest outfits in history. The plague doctor.
That long beak wasn't for show. It was stuffed with herbs, flowers and spices.
Doctors believed plague spread through bad air, called miasma. The herbs were meant to filter it out.
They carried a cane, so they could examine patients without touching them.
The real culprit was much smaller. Plague was mostly spread by fleas, carried on rats.
The waxed coat may have helped a little, by keeping the fleas off. But the herbs did nothing.
